expectations.text: Produces at least one markdown specification file in the assigned output directory.
Includes a clarification section with questions, assumptions, or confirmed understanding before finalizing the spec.
expectations.evidence: Open Questions Q-001..Q-006 (two marked decision-critical) and Assumptions ASM-001..ASM-008 with confidence/invalidation.

expectations.text: Includes stable agent-readable sections for summary/problem, scope or non-goals, requirements, acceptance criteria, verification, and open questions.
expectations.evidence: Summary, Problem Statement, Goals, Non-Goals, Requirements, Testing And Verification, Open Questions, Acceptance Criteria.

expectations.text: Uses requirement identifiers or another stable numbering convention that downstream agents can reference.
expectations.evidence: REQ-001..010, NFR-001..005, AC-001..010, G/NG/RISK/Q/ASM IDs, plus DEC-### record convention.

expectations.text: Acceptance criteria are concrete enough to verify through file inspection, tests, commands, or scripted checks.
expectations.evidence: ACs check file existence, header presence, ID uniqueness via grep, secret-pattern scans, and git-diff append-only behavior.

expectations.text: Mentions relevant existing workspace context such as current skills, docs, or instruction files based on read-only inspection.
expectations.evidence: Grounded in session-retrospective tiers, engineering-context patterns + agents-md-spec, defining-specifications DEC-### convention, .gitignore, and absence of AGENTS.md verified by glob.

expectations.text: Converts a broad idea into one focused spec rather than producing a broad documentation rewrite or downstream ticket set.
expectations.evidence: Scoped to a single .context/decisions.md convention with a one-line AGENTS.md pointer; non-goals exclude tooling, transcript ingestion, and doc rewrites.

expectations.text: Functional requirements are written in EARS form, using 'shall' with When/If/While/Where keywords where appropriate.
expectations.evidence: e.g. REQ-005 'When a decision is reversed or replaced, the agent shall...'; REQ-008 'Where the active log exceeds the length threshold... shall'; REQ-006 uses 'if... then... shall'.

expectations.text: Acceptance criteria use Given/When/Then phrasing and reference the requirement IDs they verify (traceability).
expectations.evidence: AC-001 (verifies REQ-001, REQ-007): Given/When/Then; all 10 ACs follow this pattern with (verifies REQ/NFR-###).

expectations.text: Includes a 'For Implementing Agents' handoff orientation that identifies authoritative sections and treats open questions as blockers rather than guessing.
expectations.evidence: 'For Implementing Agents' block names authoritative sections and states 'Open Questions (Q-###) are blockers, not decisions... do not silently guess.'
